description: EUHFORIA connects a coronal reconstruction with a three-dimensional heliospheric MHD model. Magnetograms and empirical boundary estimates support simulations of solar wind and coronal mass ejections. The resource is documented by University of Helsinki; KU Leuven. The documented physical domain is Solar, Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. Only the web documentation and method were verified. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The coronal interface uses empirical assumptions; model output must be checked against the intended event and location. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
